sender: Dr. Priya Patel, The Riverside Surgery
transcript:
Dear Mr. Hassan,

Following your recent blood tests, I can confirm a diagnosis of Chronic Kidney Disease, stage 3 (eGFR 52 mL/min/1.73m2). This is a common condition in men your age and we will monitor it with regular blood tests every 6 months.

I have also noted your known allergy to Penicillin (rash and swelling on previous exposure), which is now recorded on your file.

Your current regular medication is:
- Atorvastatin 20mg, once daily at night, for cholesterol

Please continue to attend your annual review and let the surgery know if you notice any swelling in your ankles or change in how much you are passing urine.

Yours sincerely,
Dr. Priya Patel
The Riverside Surgery
